Source for independently edited Japanese keyword-grid *drafts* in `web/card-keyword-grid.js`:
Tarotoo Tarot Card Meanings Dataset
https://github.com/Tarotoo-com/tarotoo-tarot-dataset
MIT License; Copyright (c) 2026 Tarotoo (tarotoo.com).

These five draft records were newly worded in Japanese from Tarotoo's published English card meanings.
They do not reproduce the Tarot Palette illustrations or the user-uploaded full keyword arrangement.
Do not publish or copy the original full keyword-list attachment without independent rights/provenance confirmation.
